To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the knowledge management practices in the higher educational institutions of Bangladesh are still in the early stages, but the institutions have started to implement some of the practices.
knowledge management can be a strategic tool for higher educational institutions, but that the implementation of knowledge management is not a simple process.

knowledge management (KM) can be a strategic tool for HRM in higher education institutions (HEIs) if the following conditions are met: (1) the institution's leadership is committed to KM; (2) KM initiatives have the support of the institution's top management; (3) the institution has an effective knowledge management strategy; (4) the institution's HRM strategy is aligned with its KM strategy; (5) the institution's KM strategy is aligned with the organization's strategic goals;
In summary, our research is concerned with
knowledge management and human resource management in higher education institutions.
the role that knowledge management (KM) plays in the strategic management of the human resource (HR) function.
the role of knowledge management in the human resources of higher education institutions.
